source_locator.description: Rani tells her father Gnanakannu that she intends to marry Raja; he refuses and reveals that Rani's husband passed away when she was young, and she learns from him that she is a widow.

translation.english_text: [Rani tells her father Gnanakannu that she intends to marry Raja. He refuses and tells her that her husband passed away when she was young. Learning from her father that she is a widow, Rani becomes deeply distressed.]
